name: loom_status
description: Read Loom's current board items, face state and Working tasks.

name: loom_show
description: Show Loom's board.

name: loom_hide
description: Hide Loom's board (items are kept).

name: loom_clear
description: Remove every item from Loom's board and hide it.

name: loom_write
description: Write a text block on Loom's board.

id.description: Stable id; reuse it to update this item in place.

name: loom_progress
description: Show or update a progress bar (value 0..1). Reuse id to move the same bar.

id.description: Stable id; reuse it to update this item in place.

name: loom_status_line
description: Show or update a one-line status with an icon state.

id.description: Stable id; reuse it to update this item in place.

name: loom_set_face
description: Set Loom's face/animation state.

name: loom_choice
description: Show clickable buttons for the user. With wait_seconds (max 50) the call waits for the click and returns it; otherwise read it later with loom_get_choice.

id.description: Stable id; reuse it to update this item in place.

name: loom_get_choice
description: Read the user's answer to a choice; optionally wait up to wait_seconds for it.

name: loom_shape
description: Draw a basic shape in the board's drawing area. x,y,w,h are fractions 0..1 of that area.

id.description: Stable id; reuse it to update this item in place.

name: loom_card
description: Show or update a card (title, body, optional badge and progress).

id.description: Stable id; reuse it to update this item in place.

name: loom_display
description: Generic renderer: add/update several board items at once. mode=replace clears the board first.

items.description: One board item. type: text{title,text} | progress{label,value 0..1} | status{label,state:info|working|success|warning|error} | choice{label,options[<=6]} | card{title,body,badge,progress?} | list{title,entries[],ordered} | shape{kind:line|arrow|rect|circle,x,y,w,h,label,filled} (coordinates 0..1 of the drawing area) | divider{label}. Any other lowercase type is kept and shown with its title/text. Optional tone: neutral|primary|secondary|tertiary|success|warning|error. Reuse an id to update that item; on update only the sent fields change.

name: loom_remove
description: Remove board items by id.

name: loom_task_list
description: List Working task cards.

name: loom_task_create
description: Create a Working task card pinned on screen. Include creator_provider=chatgpt, claude or codex for the creating agent's icon; do not guess a provider for older tasks.

name: loom_task_set_creator
description: Correct the creating agent for an existing task using verified provenance, not the title or current status. Updates only attribution metadata; does not open or move the task.

task_id.description: Working task id from loom_task_list / loom_task_create.

name: loom_task_pin_current
description: Pin Loom's current ChatGPT conversation as a Working task card (it completes itself when the reply finishes).

name: loom_task_update
description: Update a Working task's title, progress, status or summary.

task_id.description: Working task id from loom_task_list / loom_task_create.

name: loom_task_done
description: Complete a task: file its linked ChatGPT conversation into Done with verification, then remove the card. Unlinked manual tasks are removed immediately.

task_id.description: Working task id from loom_task_list / loom_task_create.

name: loom_task_reopen
description: Reopen a done Working task (status back to working).

task_id.description: Working task id from loom_task_list / loom_task_create.

name: loom_task_open
description: Open a task's exact linked Zen conversation or resume its persisted terminal session. Unlinked tasks fail closed. Voice is optional only for chat-backed tasks.

task_id.description: Working task id from loom_task_list / loom_task_create.

name: loom_web_worker_create
description: Idempotently start a background ChatGPT web worker through Loom's Zen browser bridge (UI automation; ChatGPT has no project API). Move-first: a blank chat is created in the 'New' ChatGPT project, moved to 'Working', the exact Working project id is verified from the conversation route, and only then is the prompt sent, exactly once. Returns immediately; poll loom_web_worker_inspect. Reuse request_id for retries; it never creates a second chat. Requires the six ChatGPT projects New, Vault, Working, Review, Blocked and Done to exist.

name: loom_origin_resolve
description: Read-only origin identification for the invoking ChatGPT session. Provide its last 1–3 exact user turns in order; resolves only a unique normal Mirai Zen tab, never Loom Voice. Does not move the chat or create a worker.

name: loom_origin_register
description: Persist a stable origin_ref and optionally bind its canonical ChatGPT conversation URL. The URL may be added later with a new operation_key. Replays are idempotent; key and identity collisions are refused.

name: loom_registered_origin
description: Resolve a registered stable origin_ref without browser access. Returns no URL until explicit canonical URL late-binding has occurred.

name: loom_task_bind_origin
description: Attach an existing task to its originating agent exactly once. origin_ref is the stable invoking chat/session reference; an optional origin_agent_id and name are labels, not identity credentials. Refuses to reassign an already bound task.

task_id.description: Working task id from loom_task_list / loom_task_create.

name: loom_task_send_note
description: Send a user note to this task's exact linked ChatGPT conversation or saved Codex/Claude CLI session. Reports queued first; read loom_task_list for confirmed/submitted/failed/unknown. No guessed origins or automatic resend.

task_id.description: Working task id from loom_task_list / loom_task_create.

name: loom_task_origin_link
description: Link a task to the exact ChatGPT conversation URL or persisted Codex/Claude provider session. Never guess based on a similar title. A session log enables usage limit detection.

task_id.description: Working task id from loom_task_list / loom_task_create.

name: loom_chat_title_sync
description: Request verified ChatGPT sidebar rename so its name matches the persisted Loom task title. A return of requested is NOT proof of success; inspect loom_agent_links for sync_status=synced. Works only when the Zen browser actor exposes the rename UI.

task_id.description: Working task id from loom_task_list / loom_task_create.

name: loom_agent_links
description: List persistent task ↔ ChatGPT conversation ↔ originating agent identities, including stable task/agent/chat IDs, task/display names, origin references and title sync state. A stable origin_ref (per invocation chat/session) groups callbacks for the same caller. The ID is a routing handle, not proof of a caller's identity.

name: loom_agent_events
description: Fetch durable unacknowledged replies and lifecycle events for a registered origin_agent_id. Poll this on each invocation to resume earlier tasks. An MCP server cannot force a new turn in an arbitrary ChatGPT conversation.

name: loom_agent_event_ack
description: Acknowledge a durable callback after the invoking agent has processed it. Does not implicitly approve work or mark a worker Done.

name: loom_worker_reply
description: Send a durable, idempotent message from a linked task to its recorded invoking agent. This queues a callback and a Loom notification, not an unsolicited ChatGPT prompt. An external ChatGPT agent reads it through loom_agent_events when next invoked.

task_id.description: Working task id from loom_task_list / loom_task_create.

name: loom_web_worker_inspect
description: Inspect durable and live web-worker state (phase, verified project id, lastError). A finished response becomes awaiting-review, never Done.

task_id.description: Working task id from loom_task_list / loom_task_create.

name: loom_web_worker_reconcile
description: Resume an interrupted web worker from its persisted phase (move-first state machine). Returns immediately; poll loom_web_worker_inspect. Unknown outcomes are settled by reading the conversation; it never resends an uncertain prompt and never creates a second chat.

task_id.description: Working task id from loom_task_list / loom_task_create.

name: loom_web_worker_review
description: Record an independent reviewer decision and evidence. The reviewer must differ from created_by. Approved work moves to the Done project and is marked done only after the Done project id is verified; rejected work is filed in Blocked.

task_id.description: Working task id from loom_task_list / loom_task_create.

name: loom_web_worker_route
description: File a web worker's chat into the Working, Blocked or Vault ChatGPT project and verify the project id. Never sends a message. Blocked/Vault need a reason; Done is only reachable through loom_web_worker_review.

task_id.description: Working task id from loom_task_list / loom_task_create.

name: loom_chat_route
description: Move this originating ChatGPT chat into the target project, with independent route verification. Supply its canonical url if known, a registered origin_ref, or origin_messages: the exact LAST 1–3 user messages in chronological order, copied from the invoking conversation (not a description or summary). Registered URLs are used before browser fallback. The optional automatic match requires the conversation to be open in Mirai's NORMAL Zen tabs; it refuses missing, ambiguous, short or unavailable fingerprints and does not inspect Loom Voice/worker windows. MCP transport does NOT carry a universal source chat ID: a new remote-only/mobile session still requires explicit URL registration. Never use current=true or guess from the most recent tab. Done requires reviewer and evidence.

name: loom_voice_chat_route
description: Explicitly route Loom's OWN active Voice-engine conversation, NOT the ChatGPT conversation invoking this MCP tool. Use only when the request specifically identifies Loom's Voice-engine chat. Refuses while Voice is active unless during_voice=true.

name: loom_wake
description: Summon Loom on screen (starts its ChatGPT Voice session).

name: loom_close
description: Close Loom (ends Voice and clears the board).

name: loom_notify
description: Persist a meaningful notification. Use for important milestones, urgent warnings and actionable blockers. Reuse request_id to deduplicate. Delivery is best effort; check the result.

name: loom_request_decision
description: Persist a decision requiring a user response. Options must be clear and unambiguous. Expiry, dismissal and no response mean no decision. Check loom_notification_get for the answer.

name: loom_notification_list
description: Read persistent notifications and pending decisions.

name: loom_notification_get
description: Read notification delivery and user response status.

name: loom_module_list
description: List durable Loom modules and spaces including their sizes and placements.

name: loom_module_get
description: Inspect one saved Loom module.

name: loom_module_create
description: Create a persistent Loom module. Board text/tasks render now; system/performance/floating need native renderer.

placement.description: Desired surface/anchor/geometry; only board rendering is implemented

name: loom_module_update
description: Update a saved module title, data, visibility or requested geometry.

placement.description: Desired surface/anchor/geometry; only board rendering is implemented

name: loom_module_delete
description: Delete a module and unlink it from saved spaces.

name: loom_space_list
description: List saved Loom spaces and module configurations.

name: loom_space_get
description: Read saved space and full module specs.

name: loom_space_save
description: Save or update a named reusable collection of module IDs.

name: loom_space_show
description: Open a saved space on Loom board. Returns explicit skipped modules for unsupported renderers.

name: loom_space_delete
description: Delete a saved space without deleting its reusable modules.

name: loom_idea_capture
description: Persist 1-32 ideas in the Philipedia durable inbox BEFORE delegation. Idempotent when request_id is reused. This never starts a worker.

name: loom_idea_dispatch
description: Link a captured idea to an already created top-level Claude/Codex LOOM mission. Does not start workers. Requires exact repository scope and refuses redirects.

name: loom_idea_list
description: Read every captured idea from the durable Philipedia inbox.

name: loom_tasks_snapshot
description: Read the cached Tasks tile projection (mission/idea states from the LOOM ledger, stale flag and errors). No network; never contains progress percentages.

name: loom_mission_health
description: Read whether Philipedia currently supports isolated coding worker execution.

name: loom_handoff_status
description: Read event watcher status, registered mission origins, and pending delivery count from Philipedia.

name: loom_handoff_register
description: Attach a verified origin reference and optional ChatGPT conversation URL to an existing mission. Does not send a ChatGPT message.

name: loom_mission_list
description: Read durable LOOM missions on Philipedia and their verified run/review status.

name: loom_mission_activity
description: Read recorded execution events for a LOOM mission.

name: loom_mission_create
description: Delegate a coding mission to Claude/Codex on Philipedia. Requires existing absolute repo path; do not claim completion until status verifies it.

name: loom_capability_request
description: For a requested missing feature, tool, integration or behavior change, durably save/reuse one capability gap, then dispatch at most one isolated Codex mission if Philipedia is healthy; returns state=blocked when not runnable, never claims deployment or a ChatGPT web worker.

name: loom_mission_resume
description: Resume a failed, paused, or review mission after resolving its blocker.

name: loom_gui_capabilities
description: Check which isolated graphical capabilities exist before planning GUI work. Input to the user's own desktop is never offered.

name: loom_gui_acquire
description: Create or re-acquire YOUR isolated graphical workspace (private display; never the user's desktop). Use only when a task truly needs a GUI: prefer terminal commands and APIs; use kind=browser for web pages (selector/text actions), kind=desktop for other X11 apps. request_key makes it idempotent: reuse it after reconnects or crashes to recover the same workspace instead of creating a duplicate.

name: loom_gui_list
description: List graphical workspaces (yours and others'; no tokens are exposed).

name: loom_gui_attach
description: Attach to an existing workspace you own or were granted.

workspace_id.description: Graphical workspace id from loom_gui_acquire / loom_gui_list.

name: loom_gui_grant
description: Owner only: allow another agent id to attach to your workspace.

workspace_id.description: Graphical workspace id from loom_gui_acquire / loom_gui_list.

name: loom_gui_take_control
description: Take the single pointer/keyboard of a shared workspace (agents take turns).

workspace_id.description: Graphical workspace id from loom_gui_acquire / loom_gui_list.

name: loom_gui_launch
description: Desktop workspaces: start an X11-capable app (argv list) inside the private display.

workspace_id.description: Graphical workspace id from loom_gui_acquire / loom_gui_list.

action_id.description: Optional idempotency key; a retry with the same id is not repeated.

name: loom_gui_navigate
description: Browser workspaces: load a URL (http(s), about:, file:, data:).

workspace_id.description: Graphical workspace id from loom_gui_acquire / loom_gui_list.

action_id.description: Optional idempotency key; a retry with the same id is not repeated.

description: Click. Prefer selector (CSS) or text (visible label) in browser workspaces; x/y are screen pixels of the workspace (see loom_gui_screenshot). Fails with [obscured] rather than clicking the wrong element.

workspace_id.description: Graphical workspace id from loom_gui_acquire / loom_gui_list.

action_id.description: Optional idempotency key; a retry with the same id is not repeated.

name: loom_gui_type
description: Type text into the focused field, or into selector after clicking it.

workspace_id.description: Graphical workspace id from loom_gui_acquire / loom_gui_list.

action_id.description: Optional idempotency key; a retry with the same id is not repeated.

workspace_id.description: Graphical workspace id from loom_gui_acquire / loom_gui_list.

action_id.description: Optional idempotency key; a retry with the same id is not repeated.

name: loom_gui_stroke
description: Press, drag along points [[x,y],...] at a hand-like pace, release: drawing, dragging, selecting, sliders. speed is pixels per second (default 900).

workspace_id.description: Graphical workspace id from loom_gui_acquire / loom_gui_list.

action_id.description: Optional idempotency key; a retry with the same id is not repeated.

name: loom_gui_scroll
description: Scroll by wheel steps (dy>0 down, dx>0 right), optionally over a selector or point.

workspace_id.description: Graphical workspace id from loom_gui_acquire / loom_gui_list.

action_id.description: Optional idempotency key; a retry with the same id is not repeated.

name: loom_gui_move
description: Move your visible pointer to x/y (screen pixels of the workspace) without clicking.

workspace_id.description: Graphical workspace id from loom_gui_acquire / loom_gui_list.

action_id.description: Optional idempotency key; a retry with the same id is not repeated.

name: loom_gui_screenshot
description: Capture the workspace as an image (returned inline) plus its pointer position.

workspace_id.description: Graphical workspace id from loom_gui_acquire / loom_gui_list.

name: loom_gui_state
description: Read interaction state: pointer, windows and (browser) url/title/focused element; include_text adds page text, selector returns matching elements' text.

workspace_id.description: Graphical workspace id from loom_gui_acquire / loom_gui_list.

name: loom_gui_appearance
description: Set your persistent cursor color (lavender, mint, peach, rose, sky, butter, lilac, sage, coral, aqua, or #RRGGBB) and short label.

name: loom_gui_pause
description: Pause your own workspace's input (the user may also pause it; only they can resume that).

workspace_id.description: Graphical workspace id from loom_gui_acquire / loom_gui_list.

name: loom_gui_resume
description: Resume your workspace after you paused it.

workspace_id.description: Graphical workspace id from loom_gui_acquire / loom_gui_list.

name: loom_gui_cancel
description: Cancel an in-progress action (e.g. long typing) in your workspace.

workspace_id.description: Graphical workspace id from loom_gui_acquire / loom_gui_list.

description: Release your workspace when done: closes its apps and display; keep_profile=false also deletes the private browser profile.

workspace_id.description: Graphical workspace id from loom_gui_acquire / loom_gui_list.
